# Tin tức AI nổi bật

## Chính trị & Xã hội
- Cử tri Mỹ bày tỏ sự hoài nghi sâu sắc đối với cuộc đua AI trong các cuộc bầu cử gần đây, thông qua việc phê duyệt hàng loạt lệnh tạm dừng xây dựng trung tâm dữ liệu và bầu chọn các ứng cử viên ủng hộ việc làm chậm lại khoản đầu tư 10 nghìn tỷ USD vào cơ sở hạ tầng AI. - [axios.com](https://www.axios.com/2026/11/04/ai-data-center-election-slowdown)

## Giáo dục & Công nghệ
- Google vấp phải sự phản đối khi có động thái ngừng quyền truy cập tìm kiếm đối với các trường học chặn công cụ AI của họ. - [cbsnews.com](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/google-search-access-schools-ai-tools)

## Nghiên cứu & Khoa học
- Các nhà nghiên cứu tại MIT phát triển một mô hình AI đơn giản hóa, có khả năng mô phỏng hành vi của nhiều loại vật chất khác nhau — từ cát trượt cho đến các phân tử protein — dựa trên việc học các quy luật vật lý cơ bản. -
 [news.mit.edu](https://news.mit.edu/2026/single-ai-model-simulates-many-substances-behavior-1109)

## Doanh nghiệp
- IBM và Microsoft công bố nền tảng AI agent mới, hướng tới việc chuyển đổi chuyên sâu theo từng ngành nghề và giúp doanh nghiệp tự động hóa vận hành quy mô lớn. - [news.microsoft.com](https://www.microsoft.com/source/2026/11/10/ibm-and-microsoft-announce-a-new-ai-agent-platform-designed-for-industry-specific-transformation)

items.title: Voters deliver "AI earthquake," rebuking tech and billionaires
items.summary:
AI had its "official debut" as the biggest issue in American politics, former New York Assemblymember and RAISE Act author Alex Bores told Axios. "AI is reaching into every part of our society and economy and it's now crystal clear it's impacting every part of our politics, too." [...] Voters showed deep distrust of the AI race Tuesday, approving dozens of data center moratoriums and electing a raft of candidates who favor slowing a $10 trillion buildout, including in Texas — the epicenter of the boom.

Why it matters: In an election that hinged on an affordability crisis for many Americans, voters made it clear they view Silicon Valley's AI ambitions not as a technological miracle, but as a resource-draining threat to their wallets and communities. [...] Democratic challengers successfully weaponized AI policy, ousting Republicans in Ohio, Wisconsin, Arizona and Pennsylvania.
   Democratic groups had poured ads into these districts attacking GOP incumbents for a 2025 vote that would've neutered state AI legislation.
   AI safety advocates won or were poised to win races on Tuesday that will expand their coalition in the new Congress, including Colorado's Manny Rutinel and Minnesota's Matt Little.

items.title: Deconstructing the AI Trade: AI Builders, AI Supplies and AI Products!
items.summary: With AI users, a mix of early adopters and experimenters, in a subset of industries where AI is viewed as having the most promise, will emerge. Given AI’s strengths, software businesses were among the first to be exposed to AI products, with consequences for competitive position and profitability, but AI agents also have found a foothold in white collar businesses. [...] AI users will find themselves on the receiving end of sales pitches for AI products and services, with the key selling point being improved productivity, with the warning included that not buying these products will put them at a disadvantage, relative to competitors. For AI to find its business feet, you need the customer base for AI products and services to become both wider (cutting across many different industries) and deeper (where customers spend far more on AI, on a repeat basis). [...] to show at the moment. Even if you take the ARR numbers that are being leaked by the lead players, the collective revenues from AI products and services right now is about $250 billion, a small number relative to what has been invested in the space. The entire AI ecosystem is built on the premise that this group will become much larger, both in terms of reach across businesses and money spent in the trillions of dollars.

items.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins | MIT News | Massachusetts Institute of Technology
items.summary:
Unified simulation

For this work, the researchers drew inspiration from world models. These powerful AI systems learn the rules that govern the physical world so they can predict how objects or environments will change over time in response to certain actions or conditions.

The researchers applied these concepts to develop a unified AI architecture that can simulate multiple types of physical phenomena. [...] ## More MIT News

Robot serving a cup of coffee while being instructed not to spill on the laptop

### AI-assisted learning platform helps robots reason beyond literal commands

The new approach, known as FLEX, could lead to more intuitive, interactive household and assistive robots.

Read full story →

Man wearing a T-shirt and safety goggles standing above a concrete beam in the lab, operating a bench-mounted laser tool scanning the concrete. [...] The system represents every material it simulates, from a dune of sand to a protein molecule, as tiny particles and predicts where those particles will move one step at a time. Because it learns the underlying dynamics rather than being programmed with an equation, the model can adapt to materials, forces, and environments it never encountered during training.

items.title: IBM and Microsoft announce a new AI agent platform designed for industry-specific transformation - Source
items.summary: “Clients are no longer looking for AI that simply helps people do the same work a little faster. # Thảo luận nổi bật về Rust trên Hacker News

Dưới đây là một số chủ đề bàn luận đáng chú ý về ngôn ngữ lập trình Rust trên Hacker News:

- **Lý do Discord chuyển đổi từ Go sang Rust**: Bài viết chia sẻ về quyết định chuyển dịch công nghệ của Discord sang Rust để tối ưu hóa hiệu năng, thu hút hàng nghìn điểm thảo luận và hàng trăm bình luận từ cộng đồng. - [blog.discordapp.com](https://blog.discordapp.com/why-discord-is-switching-from-go-to-rust-a190bbca2b1f)
- **Góc nhìn thực tế khi làm game bằng Rust**: Bài chia sẻ trải nghiệm sâu sắc của một lập trình viên sau 3 năm phát triển game (gamedev) bằng Rust. - [loglog.games](https://loglog.games/blog/leaving-rust-gamedev/)
- **Tài liệu học nhanh**: Bài viết hướng dẫn "A half-hour to learn Rust" giúp người mới làm quen với các khái niệm cốt lõi của ngôn ngữ này một cách nhanh chóng. - [fasterthanli.me](https://fasterthanli.me/articles/a-half-hour-to-learn-rust)
- **Mốc lịch sử quan trọng**: Thông báo chính thức phát hành phiên bản `Rust 1.0` đánh dấu bước ngoặt lớn của ngôn ngữ lập trình hệ thống này. - [blog.rust-lang.org](http://blog.rust-lang.org/2015/05/15/Rust-1.0.html)
- **Ứng dụng thực tế trong dự án nguồn mở**: Dự án `CityBound` – một tựa game mô phỏng thành phố mã nguồn mở được viết hoàn toàn bằng Rust. - [github.com](https://github.com/citybound/citybound)

items.title: Ask Claude to fact-check a headline from Russia's Pravda Network, and 31% of its answers cite Pravda Network pages. Chat
items.summary:
Ask Claude to fact-check a headline from Russia's Pravda Network, and 31% of its answers cite Pravda Network pages. ChatGPT and Meta AI did it zero times.

A University of Michigan team took 2,500 headlines from the Pravda Network, a Russian state-aligned aggregator of 110+ websites, asked each 4 ways in 11 chatbots with web search on: 104,997 answers, April to July 2026.

Three apps made 94% of the Pravda citations: https://t.co/OQoHY3lO72 at 35.0%, Claude at 31.0% and Copilot at 8.1%. Gemini did it once. The authors read the zeros as a domain blocklist at OpenAI, Google and Meta.

Claude at least warned about the source in 37.0% of those answers, close to the median. https://t.co/OQoHY3lO72 warned 5.3% of the time.

Some headlines cheat. 9.92% of them credit Bloomberg, Reuters and others while the article underneath is copied from Russian state media. On those, Claude cited the Pravda copy (28.5%) more often than the outlet the headline names (19.9%).

Each prompt ran once per app from U.S. addresses in English, and these apps change monthly. Anthropic should copy the boring blocklist the other three seem to use.

items.title: Ask Claude to fact-check a headline from Russia's Pravda Network, and 31% of its answers cite Pravda Network pages. Chat
items.summary:
Ask Claude to fact-check a headline from Russia's Pravda Network, and 31% of its answers cite Pravda Network pages. ChatGPT and Meta AI did it zero times.

A University of Michigan team took 2,500 headlines from the Pravda Network, a Russian state-aligned aggregator of 110+ websites, asked each 4 ways in 11 chatbots with web search on: 104,997 answers, April to July 2026.

Three apps made 94% of the Pravda citations: https://t.co/OQoHY3lO72 at 35.0%, Claude at 31.0% and Copilot at 8.1%. Gemini did it once. The authors read the zeros as a domain blocklist at OpenAI, Google and Meta.

Claude at least warned about the source in 37.0% of those answers, close to the median. https://t.co/OQoHY3lO72 warned 5.3% of the time.

Some headlines cheat. 9.92% of them credit Bloomberg, Reuters and others while the article underneath is copied from Russian state media. On those, Claude cited the Pravda copy (28.5%) more often than the outlet the headline names (19.9%).

Each prompt ran once per app from U.S. addresses in English, and these apps change monthly. Anthropic should copy the boring blocklist the other three seem to use.

items.title: 现在做AI漫剧，连剧本和分镜都不用自己从零写了！
items.summary:
现在做AI漫剧，连剧本和分镜都不用自己从零写了！
推荐一个开源项目 AI 漫剧 Skills，作者直接整理了21套不同材的创作模板。
玄幻修仙、穿越重生、宫斗宅斗、都市逆袭、悬疑刑侦、总裁甜宠……热门短剧材基本都有。
最厉害的是，只需要输入一句故事创意，AI 就能按照流程生成：
故事企划 → 人物设定 → 分集剧本 → 分镜提示词 → 视频生成提示词 → 发布文案。
默认支持规划30集、每集约4分钟的竖屏漫剧。
无需安装依赖，支持 Claude Code、WorkBuddy，甚至直接复制模板到 DeepSeek 就能用。
注意，它提供的是创作模板和提示词，并不会直接生成完整视频。
想做AI漫剧、短剧自媒体的朋友，这套工具值得收藏！
